info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Tips-v3-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Tips API provides insights into tips associated with various food delivery deliveries. This endpoint allows users to efficiently retrieve a list of delivery tips, which are essential for improving the service quality and customer satisfaction. Businesses in the food delivery sector can utilize this data to analyze trends, optimize driver performance, and enhance overall operational strategies. Typical consumers of this API include delivery service providers and businesses looking to analyze tipping behavior.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch information about the delivery tip, which may vary based on distance, service quality, and other factors. Use this to inform customers about applicable tips for their deliveries.

requestBody.description: Request body for fetching the tip details related to deliveries. It is essential to provide the appropriate data to receive accurate information.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the delivery tip information.
